answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in voyage, expire in pigment, and velvet lists each expiry. An copycat running 197 aliases as a result needs 151 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4690 identities would post 2483 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
